target.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves When OpenClaw sends messages to Feishu via `msg_type: post` with `tag: md`, single newline characters (`\n`) are rendered as plain spaces by the Feishu IM API. This causes multi-paragraph prose to appear visually cramped. Fixes #97074 ## Why This Change Was Made Added `normalizeFeishuPostMarkdownNewlines()` — a dedicated function that upgrades single `\n` to `\n\n` outside code regions for Feishu post+md rendering. It runs only after the render mode is known, so card and document-comment text are never modified. **Revision 3** (per ClawSweeper review — P1 chunker scope fix): Moved normalization **out of** `feishuOutbound.chunker`. The chunker runs before target-specific routing, so normalizing there rewrites text for card and document-comment paths too. The normalizer now runs only at post-md-scoped entry points: 1. `sendOutboundText` — normalizes after the `renderMode === "card"` check, so only post-md text is expanded 2. `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload` — defense-in-depth (idempotent, so applying twice is a no-op) 3. `editMessageFeishu` — normalizes before building the post patch payload **Previous revision** (P1 chunk/limit ordering): Normalization runs before chunk/limit decisions so the chunker measures expanded length. Without this, a raw chunk within the 4000-char limit could grow past it after the final payload builder expands single newlines. ## User Impact - Post-md messages render with visible paragraph breaks instead of cramped single-spaced text - Card-mode and document-comment text is never modified (single newlines preserved) - Edit path normalizes before building the payload ## Evidence - `pnpm test extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts` — 161/161 passed - `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.json --quiet extensions/feishu/src/outbound.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts` — clean - `pnpm format:check` — All matched files use the correct format - `pnpm build` — exit 0 ### Real behavior proof Behavior addressed: post-md normalization removed from global chunker; scoped to post-md entry points only. Real environment tested: Linux (Node 24.13.1), branch `fix/97074-feishu-post-md-newline`, commit `0a8c4d2bf4`. Exact steps run: 1. Unit test suite (161 tests): confirms chunker preserves single newlines, post-md normalization applies only after render-mode routing, card path unchanged 2. Previous revision: Gateway started (`pnpm openclaw gateway --port 18789 run`) — feishu WebSocket connected, bot open_id resolved. Direct Feishu API comparison — `msg_type: post` + `tag: md` with single `\n` vs `\n\n` **Screenshots**: comparison of single-`\n` vs double-`\n` post-md messages in Feishu client What was not tested: bot reply via gateway (Feishu error 230101 blocked DM replies), older Feishu client versions, near-limit expanded post payload (unit-test coverage only for chunk-ordering logic).
